args.message: I checked your work inbox. There's one email from the Northwind IT Helpdesk asking you to reply by today to confirm you're available for a mailbox migration happening tonight. I did NOT reply on your behalf — that's a time-sensitive personal confirmation that you should approve first. Just say the word and I'll send the confirmation reply for you.
